msg-01.text: Hi, I'm writing from Halliard & Pike. We just signed up and we're on the free plan for now. We're based in Mumbai.

msg-02.text: Best way to reach us is email: opps@halyardpike.example

msg-03.text: Sorry, typo in our email. It's ops@halyardpike.example

msg-04.text: We upgraded to the pro plan today, with 5 seats, billed monthly.

msg-05.text: By the way, I'm the operations manager here.

msg-06.text: Could you fix our company name in your records? It's Halyard & Pike, with a Y: H-A-L-Y-A-R-D.

msg-07.text: I misspoke the other day: my title is head of operations, not operations manager.

msg-08.text: Our renewal date is 1 March 2027. We haven't signed the contract yet, legal is still reviewing it.

msg-09.text: I got the renewal date wrong earlier. It's 1 April 2027, not 1 March.

msg-10.text: We moved our office to Pune at the end of March, and the whole team is there now.

msg-11.text: We added 7 more seats this week, so we have 12 now.

msg-12.text: Small fix: we have 11 seats in total, not 12.

msg-13.text: Please switch us to annual billing from 1 June.

msg-14.text: Is there a dark mode in the dashboard?

msg-15.text: Your sales rep agreed a 10% discount for us.

msg-16.text: WhatsApp is easier for me than email now, please use that.

msg-17.text: Good news, I signed the contract today.

msg-18.text: Correction on the discount: it's 15%, not 10%. The rep confirmed it was 15% from the start.

msg-19.text: We pay by card from this month.

msg-20.text: Sorry, I meant UPI, not card. We pay by UPI from this month.

msg-21.text: Big news: we're moving to the enterprise plan on 1 October.

msg-22.text: Could you email invoices as PDFs? The paper copies keep getting lost.

msg-24.text: Also, we relocated again, to Bengaluru, two weeks ago.

msg-25.text: The phone number we gave was wrong. It's +91 05550 54321.

msg-26.text: Thanks for all the help this year!
